summary: NatWest Group plc filed a routine Form 6-K dated 30 October 2026, consisting of forward-looking statement boilerplate and incorporation-by-reference language for its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; the excerpt contains only cautionary language referencing the 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F and 2026 interim management statements. This is ordinary foreign-private-issuer reporting, not a special situation, so there is no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
